parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing rigidity and support for other components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the doors, drawers, and shelves, maintaining the overall shape and stability of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds all other components in place.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom support structure of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and weight distribution for the entire cabinet, ensuring it stands securely on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a front panel made of MDF, attached to the frame with hinges.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space and protects the contents from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding storage compartment made of MDF, located at the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides easy access to smaller items and can be pulled out smoothly using the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along metal or wooden rails.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a horizontal panel inside the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space into sections for organized storage of items.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may be adjustable in height depending on the design.
